name: hold-up
description: A speed bump before you commit, push or deploy in a hurry.

commands.title: Hold Up: Install Git Hooks in This Repo
Hold Up: Remove Git Hooks from This Repo

holdUp.enabled.description: Show the hold-up modal before commit, push and deploy.

holdUp.countdownSeconds.description: Seconds you have to wait before Proceed unlocks.

holdUp.gate.deploy.description: Hold up before wrangler deploy and vercel deploy / --prod / promote.

holdUp.quietSeconds.description: After you proceed, skip the modal for the same kind of action for this many seconds. 0 = always ask. Fix-loops still get the modal.

holdUp.fixLoop.enabled.description: Escalate (longer wait, 'let him cook' GIF) when you look like you're in a fix-on-fix loop.

holdUp.fixLoop.commits.description: This many commits inside the window counts as a fix-loop.

holdUp.fixLoop.windowMinutes.description: Window, in minutes, used to count commits.

holdUp.fixLoop.deployAfterCommitSeconds.description: A deploy or custom command this soon after a commit counts as a fix-loop.

holdUp.customCommands.markdownDescription: Extra commands to hold up, e.g. `npm run deploy`, `terraform apply`, `docker push`. The first word is the tool (a shim is created for it, open a new terminal after changing this); the rest must be its first arguments, flags are ignored. `git` is handled by hooks and can't be listed here.

prod.description: Show the PROD pill and the extra 'I know this hits prod' checkbox.
